mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses the risk-free discount rate, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals strengthening labor market conditions, reducing recession risk and increasing corporate profit expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE declines for 3 months, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for returns vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers central bank rate hikes, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the INDPRO index falls below 100.0, it indicates a contraction in industrial production, signaling weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a contraction in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL and a rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing the cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, reducing recession risk and increasing equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100.0), a decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals worsening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0.
